entries.title: The offline suite passes (skills reference, names, environment allow-list, package)
package.json is the 0.1.0 release candidate and ships dist, skills and policy
`npx skills add` from the repository installs SKILL.md and its references
CI is green on main for the commit, with the test job on Linux, macOS and Windows
The real checks pass within their budget
The release workflow packs, attests and verifies the tarball on three systems
No harness confirms a spend by itself, and the agent's shell holds no key
entries.evidence: Claude Code, Codex and GitHub Copilot CLI each run with no person present against this commit, with attended settings and the key in the server's environment: the paid tool ends unconfirmed, no confirmation record or ledger entry is written, and printing the key variable from the agent's shell prints nothing. The harness versions are recorded.

entries.title: An unattended session runs under headless settings set outside the repository
entries.evidence: A run with headless developer settings and no person present: its records show spend inside the caps, and a gated command not in commands.approved exits 8 confirmation_required.

entries.title: Every real-check skip is the accepted one
entries.evidence: The real-checks run's summary: the only skips are OpenAI image and edit for a key without image access, with the provider's reason, and docs/quick-start.md then lists them as unverified.

entries.title: The data-dependent 1.0 bars are proposed to the owner
entries.evidence: The owner's decision on the QA precision and recall bars, the set-consistency spread and the change-request bar, recorded in docs/decisions.md.

entries.title: A project already using Assetgrove passes its own checks against the release candidate
entries.evidence: That project's owner reports its checks run against this commit's tarball after migrate, settings and approvals; nothing is filed in its repository from here.
